ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to read text in signs, menus and documents so it can be translated.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is used when you speak something to translate.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition turns what you say into text so it can be translated. When possible this happens on your device.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID unlocks Translator when App Lock is on, so only you can see your translations.
